text: Simple illustration of a photorealistic 8K render, wide-angle shot of a monumental science fiction cruiser flying high above a dense cloud layer. The ship is designed with an aggressive, utilitarian aesthetic, featuring heavily textured, matte gunmetal gray plating. Detailed visible mechanical joints and industrial paneling. A prominent, glowing blue thruster plume suggests powerful ascent. The cloudscape below is hyper-detailed, with realistic variations in fluffy cloud formations and soft shadows. Lighting is bright, clear daylight, creating strong specular reflections on the hull edges. The sky is a clean, deep blue. Shot on a high-end camera, PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials, extreme sharpness, masterpiece level detail.
